name: @pipeworx/mcp-trykitt

tools.name: trykitt_find_email
tools.description: Find a verified work email by full name + company domain (or website URL — TryKitt extracts the domain), via TryKitt.ai. Example: trykitt_find_email({ full_name: "Patrick Collison", domain: "stripe.com", _apiKey: "your-trykitt-key" })

full_name.description: Full name as it appears on LinkedIn or similar, e.g. "Patrick Collison".

domain.description: Company domain or website, e.g. "stripe.com" or "https://stripe.com".

linkedin_url.description: Optional LinkedIn profile URL to disambiguate the person.

_apiKey.description: Your TryKitt API key (get one at trykitt.ai).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-trykitt forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the trykitt pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
